hypotheses.construction_plan: Introduce the parameterized expression polygamma(theta, z). The two members are obtained by specializing theta to 0 and 1. The structural observation that diff(polygamma(0,z), z) equals polygamma(1,z) is captured as a separate exact constraint on the parameterized family, not as a direct instantiation of theta.
required_assumptions: polygamma(n, z) is defined for n=0 and n=1
The derivative relation d/dz polygamma(0,z)=polygamma(1,z) is available as a symbolic fact
hypotheses.rationale: The two terms share the same named function with consecutive first arguments, so a parameterized polygamma template explains their structural relationship without needing any simplification of the full sum.
